# A shift is only rewritten when its count is a non-negative constant or an
# unsigned variable: a negative signed count makes Go panic, and evaluating it
# once before the loop would not. simd also has no 8-bit shifts. The 64-bit
# signed right shift, which only a development toolchain has, is in
# shift_right_int64.txt.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func SignedCount(dst, a []uint32, n int) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] << n
	}
}

func Shl8(dst, a []int8) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] << 1
	}
}
